prompt:
Subject: newlywed, target meaning "新婚夫婦".

Composition: Show a joyful newlywed couple holding hands in simple wedding clothes, a small bouquet between them and matching rings visible.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. No text, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
Use only attached invidious.png as drawing-style reference. Thick rounded dark chocolate outlines, simple rounded 2D shapes, clean smooth solid color fills, few restrained flat shadow shapes. No watercolor, grain, mottling, speckles, paper texture, bleed, muddy patches or fuzzy edges. Every person has exactly two naturally attached arms and hands connected naturally to sleeves and shoulders. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows. All silhouettes clean smooth closed outlined shapes including water or grass. Avoid light beams, wind swirls and glows unless essential to word meaning.
en: Each newlywed shows a wedding ring while holding hands.
ja: 結婚したばかりの二人が手をつなぎ、結婚指輪を見せている。
